# Swage

> Agent-facing documentation index for Swage, a context-governed agent platform that runs on your own hardware. Each linked surface is the terse, canonical rendering of its subject; llms-full.txt carries the whole set in one file.

<!-- doc-index:start (generated region; do not hand-edit. Regenerate with the project-docs skill: doc-indexes.sh) -->
## General

- [Agents and permissions](agent-docs/agents-and-permissions.md): Agent definitions, operator guidance (AGENTS.md), tool permissions, approval mechanics, dispatch-bound grant intersection, effort resolution, topic-targeted session creation, context configuration, succession compaction, and voice configuration
- [First session](agent-docs/first-session.md): First-session walkthrough — start a session with or without a topic, optionally attach and trust a workspace, choose the agent it runs under
- [Interfaces and tooling](agent-docs/interfaces-and-tooling.md): Settings memory view, operator history, turn context inspector, conversation branching, image attachments and reference admission, session-owned surfaces, the surface library and annotations, workspace relinking, delivery targets, devices (registration, the dial-in connection, cancellation, and presence), tool-call recording and replay, turn completion states (incomplete, failed, interrupted, cancelled), hosted documentation and the docs_read tool, voice capabilities, gateway lifecycle (status and start recovery), wire error contract, route manifest and OpenAPI projection, verification gate, client-side route handling, the gateway's built-in tool inventory, and workspace tool output
- [Workflow engine](agent-docs/workflow-engine.md): Run lifecycle, journal/replay, budget partitions (including per-route), run detail (dispatch, provider rounds, usage, liveness, worktree completion, termination), terminal account (ending, worker partition, partial results, retention), parking, wake gate, worker sessions, cancellation, failure handover, and carried workflows
